title: Nudges
summary: A DM when tasks wait on you (on or off)
description: Whether the bot sends you a DM saying how many tasks wait on you. Off: you only see the queue channel.

title: Nudge hours
summary: The hours the bot may DM you, like 09-20
description: The hours (in your timezone) the bot may nudge you. A task that starts waiting outside them waits for the next allowed slot.

title: Nudges per day
summary: At most how many nudges you get a day
description: How many nudges the bot sends you at most in a day, and only while tasks wait on you.

title: Your timezone
summary: Your own timezone, if not the project's
description: The timezone your nudge hours are in, when it is not the project's timezone (for example while you travel). Not set: the project's.

title: Tasks in flight
summary: How many agent tasks may run at once
description: How many agent tasks may be open and not merged yet (in progress through approved). agentkit starts no new one above it, so PRs never pile up faster than people merge them.

title: Merge approved PRs by itself
summary: Merge a PR by itself once every check passes
description: When true, a PR that passes every check (and has its Human verification boxes ticked) is merged without waiting for you.

title: Split big tasks without asking
summary: Split a big task without waiting for your OK
description: When true, the agent creates a split's sub-tasks at once; otherwise the split waits for your approve.

title: Where you answer agents
summary: Answer agents on GitHub, or from Slack
description: github: answer on the issue. slack: steer from Claude Code and answer from Slack (new tasks are planned by themselves, approved PRs merge). Unset means github; gh agentkit sets the related labels and variables.

title: Slack bot cards
summary: Agent questions come to Slack as cards with buttons
description: On top of the Slack mode: true makes the workflows post cards through the agentkit Slack bot and accept its button clicks.

title: The Slack bot's GitHub App
description: The slug of the GitHub App the Slack bot sends its events as. The workflows act only on events this App sent. Empty: agentkit's own App (when the bot shares it).

validate.hint: must be a GitHub App slug

title: Card channel
summary: The Slack channel the cards go to
description: The Slack channel id (C…) the bot posts cards to.

validate.hint: must be a Slack channel id such as C0123456789

title: Runner for private repos
summary: The machine jobs run on in a private repo
description: Where jobs run in a private repo (public repos always use GitHub-hosted runners). Unset means ubuntu-latest.

validate.hint: must be a runner label

title: PR target branch
description: The branch agent PRs target. Empty means the repo's default branch.

validate.hint: must be a branch name

title: Project board number
description: The GitHub Project whose Stage and Rank fields agentkit keeps in step. Set by gh agentkit setup; empty means no board.

validate.hint: must be a project number

title: agentkit-bot App client id
description: The GitHub App the workflows act as. Set by gh agentkit; change it only when you move to another App.

validate.hint: must be a GitHub App client id

title: Tech debt share
summary: Take one tech-debt task in every N
description: agentkit takes one tech-debt task in every N it starts. 0 ranks debt like any other task.

title: Tech debt label
summary: The label that marks a tech-debt task
description: The label that marks a task as tech debt for the debt share.

validate.hint: must be one label name

title: Claude model
summary: The Claude model the agents use
description: The Claude model the agents use. Each job in agentkit.yml can set its own.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id such as claude-opus-5-5

title: Extra plugins
summary: Extra Claude Code plugins for the agents
description: Extra Claude Code plugins for one job, one NAME@MARKETPLACE per line: agentkit for agentkit's pinned ones, or the name in this repo's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.

validate.hint: must be NAME@MARKETPLACE lines

title: Refine turn limit
description: The most turns the planning agent may take on one task before it stops.

title: Implement turn limit
description: The most turns the building agent may take in one run before it stops.

title: Review turn limit
description: The most turns each review agent (code, security) may take on one PR.

title: Review attempts before it comes to you
summary: Failed review attempts before a task comes to you
description: How many failed review attempts an agent PR gets before the task comes to you (status:needs-human).

title: Wait for other CI
summary: How long to wait for other CI before asking you
description: Minutes after the head commit a check may stay pending or missing before the task comes to you.

title: Test suites (monorepo)
summary: A test suite per part of a monorepo
description: One integration suite per part of a monorepo, each on its own runner; only suites whose paths changed run. A JSON list of {name, paths, runs-on, run}; empty runs .agentkit/test.sh.

title: Checks from other CI
summary: Checks from other CI that must pass too
description: Checks another CI app posts on the commit that the gate waits for. A JSON list of {name, paths}.

title: What the daily digest lists
summary: Which lists the daily digest shows
description: One label|heading per line; each label's open tasks become a section of the digest, in this order.
default:
status:needs-info|Needs your answer
status:needs-human|Needs you
status:needs-verification|Needs your check
status:needs-approval|Needs your approval
status:approved|Approved, waiting for your merge
status:blocked|Blocked

validate.hint: must be label|heading lines

title: Days the retro covers
summary: How many days the weekly retro looks back
description: How many days the retro counts. Change the retro's cron to match.

title: Retro Discussions category
summary: The Discussions category the retro goes to
description: The Discussions category the retro is posted in.

validate.hint: must be one category name

title: agentkit version override
description: Load agentkit's scripts and plugin from another commit, branch or tag than the one agentkit.yml's uses: line pins. Empty means the pinned one.

validate.hint: must be a commit, branch or tag

title: How often agentkit checks in
description: When agentkit starts new work and re-checks other CI, in the project's timezone.

title: Daily digest time
summary: When the daily digest is posted
description: When the daily digest of what waits on you is posted, in the project's timezone.

title: Retro time
summary: When the weekly retro runs
description: When the retro runs, in the project's timezone. Match it to the retro's days.

title: Project timezone
summary: The timezone of the schedules and everyone's nudges
description: The timezone the digest, the retro and agentkit's check-ins run in, and the nudge hours of everyone who has not set their own.

title: Repos the Slack bot serves
summary: Which repos the Slack bot works with
description: The owner/repo allowlist of the Slack bot (comma-separated); it refuses any other repository.

validate.hint: must be owner/repo, comma-separated

title: Slack bot people map
description: Path, inside the bot's container, of the JSON file that maps Slack users to GitHub logins.

validate.hint: must be an absolute path

title: Slack bot's GitHub App client id
description: The client id of the GitHub App the bot mints its short-lived tokens from.

validate.hint: must be a GitHub App client id

title: Where the Slack bot keeps people's settings
description: Path, on a writable volume in the bot's container, of the JSON file with each person's nudge settings and history.

validate.hint: must be an absolute path

title: agentkit's GitHub App name, for the board
description: The slug of the GitHub App agentkit's workflows post as, so App Home items show agentkit's real question. Empty: a generic line.

validate.hint: must be a GitHub App slug

title: The Slack app's id, for nudge links
description: The Slack app id (A…), so a nudge links straight to the bot's Home tab. Empty: the nudge has no link.

validate.hint: must be a Slack app id, A…

title: Implement time limit
description: The longest a implement run (writing the code and its fix rounds) may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it comes to you.

title: Integration test time limit
description: The longest a run of the project's integration tests (each suite, when suites are set; their default is 60) may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it comes to you.

title: Review time limit
description: The longest a Claude code or security review may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it comes to you.

title: Refine time limit
description: The longest a refine run may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it comes to you.

title: Plan time limit
description: The longest a planning run may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it comes to you.

title: Planner turns
description: How many turns the planner may take to split a big task.

title: Retro turns
description: How many turns the weekly retro may take to find causes.

title: Implement model
description: The Claude model for writing the code only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Review model
description: The Claude model for the code and security reviews only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Refine model
description: The Claude model for planning new tasks only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Plan model
description: The Claude model for splitting big tasks only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Retro model
description: The Claude model for the weekly retro only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Settings model
description: The Claude model that matches a settings question in Slack to the settings. Haiku answers fastest.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Merge method
summary: Squash, merge or rebase an approved PR
description: How agentkit merges an approved PR.

title: Delete merged branches
description: true: agentkit deletes an agent's branch once its PR is merged.

title: Retry a failed run once
summary: Retry a failed agent run once by itself
description: true: a failed implement run (an API or GitHub hiccup) is retried once before it goes to a person; false: it goes to a person at once.

title: Require integration tests
summary: Fail review when the project has no tests
description: true: a PR fails review when the project has no executable test script; false: the check passes with a warning.

title: Test script
description: The project's integration test script, a path inside the repo.

validate.hint: must be a path inside the repo

title: Digest items per section
description: How many tasks the daily digest lists under each heading.

title: Retro proposals
description: How many changes the weekly retro may propose at most.
